summary: Frontend-only testing of V6-TURBZ static build (dist-static on :3000, mock API) at the public preview URL. Ran Playwright scripts at 1920x1080, reading engine state through window.__turbz. WORKING: Class picker (30 classes). Role, style and gimmick-tag filters combine correctly (e.g. transform+melee gives nightblade and bloodrager). class-gimmick and class-perks render. Crying Girl customizer: element and role update the card text and details, the style chip toggles, the stat-lean budget stops at 40/40 with + disabled, lowering a stat frees points, and Clear works. Perk builder: 87 perks (58 new / 29 legacy), class search works, max 4 picks with the rest disabled. Config and perks are saved in localStorage across reloads and applied in game (sheet shows 'Crying Girl · Electric · Caster', perk hooks dodge=14 and firstStrike=35 are active). Gimmicks: Nightblade cat gives exactly 4x speed (132 to 528) with the cat sprite, 'Ns left', and cooldown plus POUNCE after it ends. Moonhopper rabbit shows the ring aura and hops toward the mouse. Phasewalker double-click teleports to the cursor, is refused during cooldown and works again after it. Hexbinder Wraith Veil runs 20s and the player is translucent. Bloodrager with no bosses killed shows 'No trophies yet', 'Skins 0' and the empty catalog. After a forced boss kill the catalog fills, and boss form activates with the chosen skin. Verses Library: verse-count updates right away on every role/effect/shape toggle, the role counts add up to 396, combined filters narrow the list, Reset shows the active filter count and clears them, the source chips work (My class=7, Signature=64, Starfall=44), and all sort options plus the direction flip reorder the list. Tags show role, 'N hits' and '★ Class'. Multi-hit verses land every hit (Dragon Combo 5, Thousand Cuts 5, Monsoon 5, Veil Storm 3 resolveHit calls) with no console errors. Each non-custom class tested starts with 7 verses including 2 signature ones. Autoplay: one 24s run was fine (level 1 to 6, moving and fighting, 0 errors). BUGS: (1) The boss catalog popup cannot be seen or clicked: the hotbar's overflow clips it and the HUD menu sits on top of it, so the trophy skin buttons cannot be picked. (2) Crying Girl starts with only 6 verses, all Water spells, whatever element or style you pick. (3) In one autoplay run the character stood still at the same coordinates for about 20s while losing HP (status 'resting', combat=2) and died to a level-7 Spirit Nobi at level 2. (4) Spirit Caller's Choir Lead can be used with 0 spirits: it does nothing and still starts its 38s cooldown.

ui_bugs.issue: The boss-catalog popup is absolutely positioned above the R slot inside .hotbar, which has overflow-x:auto, so it is clipped. The .hud-menu toolbar also sits over it: elementFromPoint at a boss-form-* button returns hud-moves-btn. A real user cannot pick a trophy skin. The mechanic itself works when the button's click is fired from code.
Choir Lead goes active and starts its 38s cooldown even with 0 spirits in the party. It does nothing and gives no message. It should refuse with a message like Bloodrager's 'No trophies yet'.

The class text says 'the first hit after you leave cat form always crits double', but dealMult only multiplies damage by 2 and does not force a crit. Also, the class perk is named 'Pounce' and the gimmick float is also 'POUNCE', which is confusing.
Pressing R again to leave cat or rabbit form early still charges the full cooldown plus the whole duration (cd = cdMax + dur is set when it activates). Leaving early gives nothing back.

integration_issues.issue: STARTER_KITS.cryinggirl has 4 moves plus 2 signature moves, so her bar has 6 verses where other classes have 7. All her verses are Water spells (Tear Lance, Sob Wave, ...) even when Electric or Fire is chosen with melee or ranged style. The side-element +5% Affinity then boosts verses she does not have. The element and style choices do not change her moves.

Intermittent: in 1 of 2 runs the player stayed at exactly the same position from t=5s to t=25s with combat=2 and the tracker showing 'Autoplay · resting'. HP drained from 86 to death against a Spirit Nobi (level 7) while the player was level 2. Likely cause: autoRest only flees from foesNear(220) threats that are not animals, so a ranged or ghost attacker outside 220px, or a sleep/silence effect, leaves autoplay standing still. Autoplay also does not struggle out of sleep. The other run was healthy (level 1 to 6).

issues: The 'Skins N' button below the R slot makes the hotbar taller and pushes the HUD menu up compared with other classes.
'✦ Starfall' appears twice (source chip and show chip) with the same meaning.
The direction flip does nothing for 'By element' sort. 'By name' with the default '▼ High first' sorts Z to A.
Ascending dps/reach sorts put auras and Pow 0 utility moves first.

action_items: Fix the boss catalog popup: render it outside the overflow:auto .hotbar (portal, or position fixed with a higher z-index than .hud-menu) so the boss-form-* buttons can be seen and clicked.
Give Crying Girl a 7th verse and make her kit follow the chosen element (and ideally the fight style), or state clearly that her moves are always Water.

Autoplay: while autoRest is on and HP is dropping, flee from or fight the actual attacker (track the last attacker, including ranged or ghost foes beyond 220px), and mash to struggle when asleep or rooted. Consider not engaging foes several levels higher at level 1-2.
Spirit Caller: refuse Choir Lead when g.mates is empty, with a float message, and do not start the cooldown.
Nightblade: make pounce force a crit, or change the text. Optionally refund part of the cooldown when a form is cancelled early.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.ts is 12k lines and game-panels.tsx is 1.2k lines, far over the 700-line guideline. The new gimmick and witch logic is split out, which is good.
class-gimmicks.ts activate(): cd = cdMax + dur is added to the duration for every gimmick, so the R slot shows 'Ns left' and then the cooldown. Fine, but cancelling a form early wastes it.
witch-brain.ts: after a potion, 'fleeing' (hp<30% && potT>0) can last the whole 20s potion timer, so a witch that stays under 30% keeps running away instead of fighting.
VersesPanel sort: the 'type' sort ignores dir, and the 'name' sort is reversed by default.
classes.ts applyCry replaces the Crying Girl's base stats with the lean, so the original affinity +5 disappears once a custom lean is set (expected if intended).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested flows pass except boss-catalog clicking, Crying Girl 7-verse/element kit, and one flaky autoplay death)

seed_data_creation: Changed runtime state only through window.__turbz to test: moved the player next to mobs, set a mob boss=true and hp=1 to get a trophy (bossId TEST_boss_*), and set HP. localStorage turbz.cryingConfig and turbz.cryingBuild were changed by the customizer tests.
flaky_tests: Autoplay stood still and died in 1 of 2 runs (50%)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project is at /app/work/game/V6-TURBZ-main. dist-static is served on :3000 by python http.server and the mock API by /app/work/mock.py; do not touch supervisor. Flow: TurboHunt -> New hunt -> class-card-<id> -> create-go-btn -> Escape. Engine is window.__turbz (save, gim, mobs, resolveHit, cds). Combat auto is on by default and casts by itself; click the 'Combat auto' button (its label then changes to 'Combat manual') before testing key casts. Occasional 502s on MapAssets come from the single-threaded python http.server through ingress, and the 404 for music/veil.ogg/mp3 is a missing asset; neither is an app bug. Rival witch AI (witch-brain.ts) was only code-reviewed, not exercised at runtime (no witch spawned near the start).
test_credentials: none required (mock API auto sign-in); /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty
